title: NFIB Illinois PAC Announces 2026 Legislative Endorsements
generalEvidence: Dated "August 25, 2026" (after the March 17, 2026 primary): "NFIB Illinois PAC announced its state legislative endorsements today ... The following legislators are officially endorsed by NFIB IL PAC"
whyItCounts: Small-business federation PAC; endorsements based on its small-business voting record and positions.
note: Only entries for districts on the Cook County ballot are transcribed (Senate 24, 26, 41; House 20, 52, 79). The rest of the list is downstate/collar-county districts. NFIB FedPAC's Oct 1, 2026 congressional endorsements (IL-12, IL-15, IL-16) are outside Cook.

verify.general: yes: release dated August 25, 2026 (after the March 17, 2026 primary) endorsing named nominees for state legislative seats; it does not say "November 3" or "general election" in words, but the date makes it a general-election endorsement list.
verify.note: WebFetch got 403; read in Chrome. All 6 Cook-ballot entries appear ("District 24 Seth Lewis" etc.). Checked the rest of the list against the contests file: no other listed district is on the Cook ballot. "Marty McLaughlin" = ballot name Martin McLaughlin (HD-52).
